objectives.title: Read the flag
objectives.prompt: Log in to the MetaCorp portal and abuse the Benefit Forms feature to read /ctf/flag from the server.
hints: Benefit Forms lets you download the forms HR provides: look at the parameters of the download link.
The download action builds an object from a class name you send and serves the path you send. The upload's backup option is a second way in (a shell command).

steps.title: Find the feature
steps.prompt: Which portal page lets you download and upload documents?

steps.title: Find the input
steps.prompt: Which parameter of the download request holds the path of the file served?

steps.title: Find the class switch
steps.prompt: Which parameter names the Ruby class the controller instantiates with that path?

steps.title: Name the flaw
steps.prompt: Which vulnerability class lets you download any file the server can read?
